Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 19621 of 2024

Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following relief:
"(i) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondent no. 2 and 3 to conduct the fair and proper investigation in pursuance of the first information report dated 21.4.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 0176 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 504, 506 and 354 IPC, Police Station:
Hanumant Vihar, Dakshini (Commissionerate Kanpur Nagar).

sentences.text: (iii) Issue a writ order or direction, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
(iv) Award the cost of the petition to the petitioner."

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though the FIR in the instant case has been registered on 21.4.2024, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the Police Commissioner,
Police Commissionerate, Kanpur Nagar, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved before the Police Commissioner, Police Commissionerate, Kanpur Nagar, the Police Commissioner, Police Commissionerate, Kanpur Nagar/respondent no. 2 shall ensure the fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5.
